scenarios.name: real_chrome_initial_document_timeout_preserves_owned_page
scenarios.title: Keep the owned page when the initial HTTP document exceeds the startup budget
scenarios.workflow: Start actual Chrome with a held initial response -> startup timeout retains process and owned target -> release response -> reconnect same session and target -> one GET and one trusted submission
scenarios.user_problem: A temporary empty document must not be reported ready or cause startup navigation to be replayed.

scenarios.name: real_chrome_startup_target_first_navigation
scenarios.title: Keep the first navigation on the owned page while an early startup page finishes
scenarios.workflow: Launch actual Chrome -> arrange an early startup page -> finish browser_start -> first owned navigation held by HTTP -> independent early page navigates to blank -> release one request -> correct owned page -> trusted typing and one submission
scenarios.user_problem: An early Chrome startup page must not cancel or replace the first application navigation.

scenarios.name: real_chrome_startup_target_explicit_url
scenarios.title: Load the requested startup URL once on the owned page
scenarios.workflow: Launch actual Chrome with URL -> independent early page exists -> startup returns owned identity -> hold initial HTTP request -> early page finishes to blank -> requested page loads once -> trusted typing and one submission
scenarios.user_problem: Chrome startup must keep the requested URL and target identity without replaying navigation.

scenarios.name: real_chrome_startup_navigation_cancellation
scenarios.title: Inspect the actual destination after Chrome reports an aborted startup navigation
scenarios.workflow: Own Chrome target -> hold first HTTP request -> competing owned driver navigates -> real ERR_ABORTED -> inspect URL and readiness -> verify destination DOM -> helper dispatched only once
scenarios.user_problem: A startup navigation race must not trigger blind replay or hide a wrong destination.

steps.description: Force the cancellation using actual HTTP and Chrome/CDP actors

scenarios.name: real_chrome_startup_wrong_destination_is_refused
scenarios.title: Keep a cancelled navigation failed when Chrome settles on another page
scenarios.workflow: Own Chrome target -> hold first request -> actual competing redirect to wrong page -> ERR_ABORTED -> read-only inspection -> failure -> exactly one helper request
scenarios.user_problem: Navigation recovery must not hide a wrong destination or dispatch input again.

steps.description: Force a real abort to another destination and verify refusal without replay
